hero_description: Who we are and how we work.
founder_paragraph_1: Florence Chioma, who most customers know as Floxxy, started C.Zara Enterprise in 2021. The business is based in Kurudu, FCT, Abuja.
founder_paragraph_2: We serve households and businesses in Abuja and beyond with natural honey, nuts, palm oil, foodstuffs and gift selections.
founder_paragraph_3: Every order is handled personally. Message or call Florence and she will confirm what is available, today's price and delivery.
